title: Interchanging the spatial arguments of coherent transformation spaces
statement:
Use universes, quasicategories, coherent functors, transformations and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the space category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and coherent Hom bifunctors with precomposition and postcomposition as in [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality]. Fix universes $\mathcal V\in\mathcal V'$. For every $\mathcal V$-small quasicategory $M$, the mapping spaces of $\mathcal F_M=\operatorname{Fun}(M,\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$, formed in a containing universe, admit $\mathcal V$-small Kan models; coherent Hom bifunctors can be chosen with values in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$. Let $K,L$ be $\mathcal V$-small quasicategories, and let $F:K\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$, $Q:L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ and $W:K^{\mathrm{op}}\times L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ be coherent functors. Transpose $W$ to $K^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal F_L$ and form the coherent functors
$$R_Q:K\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V},\quad R_Q(k)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal F_L}(W(k,-),Q),\qquad T_{F,Q}:K^{\mathrm{op}}\times L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V},\quad T_{F,Q}(k,l)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}}(F(k),Q(l)).$$
Evaluation and transposition induce an equivalence of whole mapping spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal F_K}(F,R_Q)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal F_{K^{\mathrm{op}}\times L}}(W,T_{F,Q}).$$
On component evaluations it sends $\alpha:F\to R_Q$ to $\tau:W\to T_{F,Q}$ with $\tau_{k,l}(w)(x)=\alpha_k(x)_l(w)$, where this expression denotes the coherent evaluation map, not merely its map on components. The equivalence is natural coherently in $F,Q,W$, commutes with restriction in $K$ and $L$, and with additional simplicial parameters in any containing universe. Empty shapes and empty values are allowed.

source.place: Agent-formulated two-variable tensor-Hom interchange based on the coherent-end formula of Kerodon Example 8.3.4.22 (03P7), read online 2026-10-17; local smallness is Cisinski, Higher Categories and Homotopical Algebra, Proposition 5.7.3 (printed p.244), which directly states local smallness of Fun(M,S) for any small simplicial set M, https://cisinski.app.uni-regensburg.de/CatLR.pdf. The displayed interchange is a transposition consequence, not quoted verbatim from 03P7. No Stacks Project tag states this quasicategorical assertion; archival copies WANTED.
